oneLiner.zh: 严格先问再开（Opt-in）且公开作者样本日志；小扣分是 10% 抽样弹窗默认选项为 [Yes]、同意后开异常自动捕获，且不认 DO_NOT_TRACK=1。
oneLiner.en: Strictly opt-in with public sample analytics logs; minor caveats: 10% prompt defaults to [Yes], enables exception autocapture once opted in, and ignores DO_NOT_TRACK.

title.zh: 10% 随机弹窗默认选项为 [Yes]，且不支持 DO_NOT_TRACK
title.en: 10% opt-in prompt defaults to [Yes]; no DO_NOT_TRACK support

summary.zh: 未同意前不会初始化 PostHog，但询问弹窗默认回车即同意，同意后开启 enable_exception_autocapture=True。
summary.en: PostHog stays off until confirmed, but `confirm_ask` defaults to `[Yes]` and opted-in clients enable `enable_exception_autocapture=True`.

mitigationNote.zh: 运行一次 aider --analytics-disable 即可永久写入本地禁用标记。
mitigationNote.en: Run `aider --analytics-disable` once to permanently disable analytics.
